narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The width grew by thirty but the height grew only by twenty, so D is not proportional.
<bookmark mark='why'/>He compared the amounts added, not the factors.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A bigger side grows by more, so the added amounts cannot be the test.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Find the factor for each side, and call the change proportional only when the two factors match.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Eigh card is four by two centimetres, so is six by three proportional, and is five by three?
